ports.tagline: Fallout 1 CE rebuilt for touch on the AYN Thor: Pip-Boy 2000 theme, bottom-screen dashboard, 16:9 widescreen. Early, playable.
Fallout 2 CE rebuilt for touch screens in landscape, with a bottom-screen companion for dual-screen handhelds. Beta, fully playable.
Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius (2001), rebuilt as a C++ reconstruction that runs natively on the AYN Thor. Release candidate, about 95%.
Jimmy Neutron vs. Jimmy Negatron (2002), rebuilt natively for the Thor, with widescreen and a second-screen panel. Complete (v1.0).
Rollerbot: A Time Journey (2000), a fan reconstruction for the AYN Thor and Linux (Flatpak). About 85% done.
SpongeBob SquarePants: Employee of the Month (2002), a preservation port for the AYN Thor. About 88% done.
